{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter out the -1 values (missing age) as per documentation
valid_ages = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

# Also compute the number of valid ages to report in evidence
n_valid = len(valid_ages)

# Print both values
print(f"Mean age: {mean_age}")
print(f"Number of valid age entries: {n_valid}")"}
